ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with concentrated high-intensity (white/light-grey) regions on distal lobes; estimated 75:25 ratio of black to white pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across the central fluke and notch area. Large, mottled white/light-grey patch on the right lobe extending from the mid-section to the distal tip. Smaller, fragmented white patch on the far-left distal tip. Interface regions show high-frequency stippling/mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with jagged peaks and valleys. Frequency of serration is higher on the right lobe compared to the left. Distinct rounded protrusions on the right distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white circular clusters (barnacles) localized on the extreme right distal tip. Isolated circular white scar pixels scattered within the black pigmentation of the lower-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of approximately five vertical, parallel dark-pixel streaks (rake marks) crossing the white patch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on the right fluke tip; vertical rake marks on the right lobe; irregular scalloping on the right trailing edge indicating possible past trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-contrast water droplet interference across the central vertical axis; visible dorsal fin or peduncle edge on the far left frame partially occluded by splashing.
